rule: v36 is the stage choice with the highest probe B measure; no final evaluation unless it is above 0; its probe B figure is selected (the best of up to three) (predeclared.md). Stage 1's measure is in points at levels 29 and up, the others' in total score: stage 1's agent plays v29r20d's own game below 230 lines (prefix guard), so its total score differs from v29r20d's only there, and the 29+ form leaves out the probe half's luck below 230. The one-scale rule covers the training rows' values; inside backup2 a board's leaves are valued by the network the target is computed under (033's recipe).
